entries.reason: OceanBase Oracle mode follows Oracle FLOAT(p), which is a NUMBER subtype with decimal/binary precision semantics rather than BINARY_FLOAT/BINARY_DOUBLE.
Oracle FLOAT(p) is a NUMBER subtype; only BINARY_FLOAT and BINARY_DOUBLE are binary floating-point source types.
Elasticsearch half_float is a 16-bit floating-point type and is outside the TapFloat/TapDouble 32/64-bit scope.
Elasticsearch scaled_float is a scaled long representation, not a binary32/binary64 type.
